title: Anti-theft features and GPS after theft
summary: This topic combines requests for stronger anti-theft and recording features with unclear mentions of anti-theft use cases and a GPS location issue after a theft.

positive.summary: Positive feedback highlights a desire for always-on camera recording as a theft-deterrence feature similar to Tesla's setup.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the need for improved anti-theft protection, an anti-theft-related safety function, and a GPS showing an incorrect location after a theft without enough context to classify sentiment.

limitations: The topic mixes several loosely related subjects, including anti-theft feature requests, a safety-related anti-theft mention, and a GPS issue after theft.
Most sampled evidence is undetermined, so the available examples are insufficient to draw a clearer sentiment pattern.
One undetermined example describes a GPS location problem after theft, but the fragment alone does not establish whether the issue is with theft recovery, navigation, or another system behavior.
